name: growth-skills
description: Growth teardowns for mobile subscription apps, for product designers: web funnel, onboarding, the onboarding-paywall seam, upsells, the first weeks before renewal and the cancel flow. Each returns a 100-point score for what can be changed on screen (never rewarding pressure), store and dark-pattern flags, a report card and ranked test ideas grounded in published tests and public benchmarks. A router picks the right one. Installs subscription-skills for benchmarks, paywall teardown and store rules.
